newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil stronger.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was notionally stronger in line with crude but good supply and poor demand continued to pressure price, traders said.
A refiner in the U.K. sopught material but only wanted to pay well below sellers' prices, which were around $131 fob NWE.

Russian fuel oil continues to emerge from Russia. Geneva-based consultants Petrologistics said fuel oil exports into the Baltics and the Black Sea were 160,000 tonnes in the third week of January, compared with 250,000 and 180,000 tonnes in the second and first weeks respectively. Traders said there was no let-up in the flow rate from the Baltics this week.
